Team,

Heading into the end-of-month QBR I want to align owners and deliverables for the monthly KPI dashboard. Key asks:

- Confirm a 1-paragraph explanation for each metric (latency, cost, uptime, usage) that we can paste into the QBR slide.
- Surface any incidents or rollouts that materially affected the numbers (time window + root cause).
- Final artifacts due Tue 2026-06-23 10:00 PT.

Owner suggestions (please ack / reassign):
- Latency (p95/p99): Jonas
- Cost (unit economics + embeddings): Laura
- Uptime (customer-facing SLA metrics): Grace
- Usage (active customers / RU trends): Vivek

Attached: monthly_kpi_dashboard_0620.pdf (dashboard export), qbr_ask_template_0620.xlsx (slide copy template)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AexampleDashboard
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: KPI convergence — QBR readiness and OKR owners huddle

Ack — I'll take latency.

Quick signal:
- p95 inference latency: 320ms (down 8% MoM). p99: 1.2s (target p99 <1s)
- Noted a spike on 2026-06-15 between 03:00-04:30 PT after the A/B rollout (KV cache warmup miss)

Immediate mitigation we applied: reverted the rollout for subset B, increased pre-warm windows, and added a short-term KV-cache priming job. I'll write a 2-3 sentence blurb with the root cause and what we did.

On Tue 2026-06-22 09:00 PT I'm available — please send invite.

—Jonas
